unmarried.label: Unmarried
unmarried.help: You do not need to list a spouse. List all eligible children.

married.label: Married and my spouse is NOT a U.S. citizen or U.S. LPR
married.help: You must list your spouse, even if they will not immigrate with you. Each spouse may submit a separate entry as the principal applicant.

marriedus.label: Married and my spouse IS a U.S. citizen or U.S. LPR
marriedus.help: A spouse who is already a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident must not be listed.

divorced.label: Divorced
divorced.help: You do not need to list a spouse. Include qualifying stepchildren from a previous marriage.

widowed.label: Widowed
widowed.help: You do not need to list a spouse. List all eligible children.

separated.label: Legally Separated
separated.help: Do not list a spouse if you are legally separated by formal court order. Informal separation does not qualify; seek legal advice.

checklist: Read the official instructions, dates and eligible-country list at dvprogram.state.gov
Valid passport(s) and JPEG scans of the identity and signature pages are ready
Birth certificates and civil documents gathered
Secure personal email account (strong password and two-factor authentication)
Entry will be submitted only at dvprogram.state.gov, without an intermediary
Reviewed every field carefully before submitting
Saved confirmation(s) offline (PDF, number and date of birth)
Will check results only through Entrant Status Check
If selected: DS-260, visa fees, civil documents, police certificates and medical exam
If both entries are selected: confirm with the consulate the single procedure to follow
guide: The draw is random: no agent, software or “method” can improve your odds. Your only control is submitting a valid entry and being ready if selected.
Duplicate entries disqualify all your entries. A married couple may each submit one lawful entry as the principal applicant.
List your spouse and all unmarried children under 21, even if they will not immigrate with you. Omissions can lead to a visa refusal for the whole family.
Use the name on your passport
Keep the same spelling, order and name fields everywhere (entry, DS-260 and documents). A valid passport is required for the principal applicant from DV-2027.
600 × 600 px, JPEG, maximum 240 KB, taken within 6 months, plain background, no filters or retouching. Have it taken by a professional.
Education: a high school diploma qualifies
High school completion (12 years), or 2 years of qualifying work experience within the past 5 years (O*NET, Job Zone 3 or higher).
If someone helps you complete the entry, keep your own email and confirmation number. Without them, you cannot check the result.
dvprogram.state.gov. Official emails do not announce a win, and no one can guarantee selection. Entry fee: $1 per entry.
Birth and marriage certificates, diplomas, police certificates and valid passports: timelines after selection can be short.
faq: What is the DV Lottery (Diversity Visa)?

The U.S. government’s annual program makes immigrant visas available through a random draw to people born in countries with historically low immigration to the United States. Entries are submitted only at dvprogram.state.gov.

You must be born in an eligible country (or qualify through a spouse or parent under chargeability rules) and have a high school education or qualifying work experience in the past 5 years (O*NET). A valid passport is required for the principal applicant starting with DV-2027.
Can a married couple submit two entries?

Yes. Each spouse may submit a separate entry as the principal applicant and list the other spouse and all eligible children. This gives the family two entries, not each person better odds. Each person may submit only one principal entry.
JPEG, 600 × 600 pixels, no more than 240 KB, taken within 6 months, plain background, no filters or retouching. Atelier DV checks your file on your device; it is never uploaded.
Dates vary by program year and are announced by the Department of State. Check travel.state.gov. Atelier DV displays official announcements when they are published.
Does Atelier DV submit an entry for me?
No. The tool helps you prepare, check and organize your information. You submit your entry yourself at dvprogram.state.gov. Atelier DV is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.
